They also have lower international revenue exposure and less concentration. We find sector exposure can explain a large proportion of the returns of US Small Caps. However, there has been a divergence YTD, suggesting a more idiosyncratic driver over this shorter period, which we find is coming from sentiment rather than fundamentals. In terms of fundamentals, we find the absolute levels of profitability are lower. Growth, on the other hand is higher and this is what drives the higher PE. We find US Small Caps are more sensitive to macroeconomic variables compared to Large Caps. While we find no evidence of an unconditional small cap premium, we see strong evidence that buying at attractive valuation levels will lead to high forward returns.
